description: Classify a selected image as hotdog or not hotdog for entertainment.

defaultPrompt: Is this image a hotdog or not hotdog?
Give this image a frank assessment.
interface.longDescription: Get a playful HOTDOG, NOT HOTDOG, or UNCERTAIN verdict for an image shared in ChatGPT or Codex, using the host assistant. A separate companion extension adds browser hover checks using a model on your device. No publisher API key is used. Installing the chat plugin does not install the extension. Normal host usage limits apply.

name: not-hotdog
